For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Appendix B, Nullological Operators, Coalesce<T>(arguments List<T>) and Coalesce<T>(argument1 T, argument2 T, argument3 T, argument4 T, argument5 T)
issues.evidence: Fresh EXPLORER direct public helper probe showed SELECT "Coalesce"(NULL, false), SELECT "Coalesce"([NULL::BOOLEAN, false]), and IsTrue/IsFalse over those results raised DuckDB TypeMismatchException or returned false predicates instead of preserving Boolean false/true across forced Python fallback and native-loaded registrations.
issues.root_cause: Python Coalesce returned raw Python bool values through a DuckDB VARIANT-returning UDF, which DuckDB rejected during result conversion; IsTrue/IsFalse macros also only accepted typeof(x) = BOOLEAN and therefore ignored Boolean values transported as VARIANT.
issues.resolution: Wrap Boolean Coalesce return values as explicit DuckDB VARIANT values when VARIANT is available, and teach IsTrue/IsFalse to recognize VARIANT JSON true/false while keeping string and numeric truthiness rejected.
issues.verified_in: CQL-08 EXPLORER: .temp/qa/cql08_explorer_probe.py; test_nullological_parity.py 11/11; official nullological compliance 44/44; adjacent parity 77/77; full conformance 2822/2822

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Appendix B, Nullological Operators, Coalesce<T> returns the first non-null T; CQL Quantity comparisons require unit-aware Quantity semantics
issues.evidence: Fresh EXPLORER translated probe showed Coalesce((from {null as Quantity, 5 'mg'} Q return Q)) = 5 'mg' returned SQL NULL, and Coalesce({null as Quantity, 5 'mg'}) = 5 'mg' could fall into scalar comparison instead of quantity_compare.
issues.root_cause: Quantity-producing Coalesce expressions and query-list Coalesce expressions did not carry Quantity type evidence into comparison translation, so the generic comparison path reduced or cast Quantity JSON instead of dispatching to quantity_compare.
issues.resolution: Extend Quantity inference to recognize SQL COALESCE branches containing Quantity values and CQL Coalesce/list/query expressions that produce Quantity values, preserving whole-Quantity Coalesce results for unit-aware comparison.
issues.verified_in: CQL-08 EXPLORER: .temp/qa/cql08_explorer_probe.py; test_nullological_parity.py 11/11; official nullological compliance 44/44; full conformance 2822/2822

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Appendix B, Nullological Operators, Coalesce<T> over Boolean values returns Boolean T; Quantity.value is Decimal, not Quantity
issues.evidence: Fresh EXPLORER Patient-context probe showed Coalesce(Patient.active, false) lowered through numeric/VARCHAR paths and could fail binding or erase Boolean values. Full conformance then exposed CMS832 failing with a mixed list_value(VARCHAR, INTEGER) binder error after Quantity Coalesce inference made IndexCreatinine(...).value / 0.9 look Quantity-valued.
issues.root_cause: Coalesce numeric detection treated Boolean SQL literals as numeric because bool is an int subclass, and Quantity inference recursively treated .value on a Quantity-producing source as another Quantity rather than Decimal.
issues.resolution: Exclude Boolean literals from Coalesce numeric detection, route FHIR Boolean path arguments paired with Boolean Coalesce defaults through fhirpath_bool, and stop propagating Quantity type through Quantity.value property access.
